title: Statements Regarding Border Land Claims and Security Alert
summary: Recent reports discuss statements made by a Nepali official concerning land claims and a security alert issued in Delhi.
summary_points: A Nepali official reportedly stated that Nepal also occupies Indian land.
This statement was made to the Nepali Parliament.
A security alert was issued in Delhi following the unearthing of a terror module.
Security has been tightened along the India-Nepal border.
title_hi: सीमा भूमि दावों और सुरक्षा अलर्ट से संबंधित बयान
summary_hi: हालिया रिपोर्टों में भूमि दावों के संबंध में एक नेपाली अधिकारी द्वारा दिए गए बयानों और दिल्ली में जारी सुरक्षा अलर्ट पर चर्चा की गई है।
summary_points_hi: एक नेपाली अधिकारी ने कथित तौर पर कहा कि नेपाल भी भारतीय भूमि पर कब्जा करता है।
यह बयान नेपाली संसद में दिया गया था।
एक आतंकी मॉड्यूल का भंडाफोड़ होने के बाद दिल्ली में सुरक्षा अलर्ट जारी किया गया था।
भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर सुरक्षा कड़ी कर दी गई है।

sources.headline: नेपाल ने भारत की जमीन पर अतिक्रमण किया है..., PM बालेन शाह के बयान का क्या असर होगा? - Zee News
sources.framing: This outlet highlighted the statement by PM Balen Shah regarding Nepal's alleged encroachment on Indian land and questioned its potential impact.

center.framing: Center-leaning outlets reported on the statement made by PM Balen Shah to the Nepali Parliament regarding Nepal's alleged occupation of Indian land.

right.framing: Right-leaning outlets reported on the unearthing of a terror module in Delhi, the tightening of security on the India-Nepal border, and also covered PM Balen Shah's statement about Nepal's alleged encroachment on Indian land.

divergence: The coverage shows some divergence in focus. While all outlets reported on the statement by PM Balen Shah regarding land claims, Zee News (right-leaning) also included a report about a terror module in Delhi and heightened security on the India-Nepal border, which was not explicitly mentioned by The Lallantop (center-leaning) in the provided summaries.
omissions: The Lallantop's summary does not mention the security alert or the tightening of security on the India-Nepal border, which was reported by Zee News. Conversely, Zee News's summary about the land claim does not explicitly state that the statement was made to the Nepali Parliament, as mentioned by The Lallantop.
